name: BloomLordmon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your Digimon. Then, gain 1 memory for each suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in one of their traits you have in play. If you gain 2 or more memory by this effect, unsuspend this Digimon and it gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[Your Turn] For every 2 suspended Digimon you have in play, this Digimon gets +2000 DP and gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
